subject.title: fix: reconcile timed-out gateway message actions

question: Is same-process-only reconciliation sufficient for timed-out Gateway message actions despite restart and long-tail timeout gaps?
rationale: The patch correctly uses the current idempotency contract, but in-flight and completed action state is memory-only and the follow-up wait is finite; tests cannot determine the intended product-level delivery guarantee.

options.title: Accept after live proof
options.body: Merge after a real delayed channel run proves exactly one visible delivery, and track restart-durable reconciliation separately.

options.title: Require durable reconciliation
options.body: Pause until same-key outcomes survive Gateway restart and remain authoritative throughout the intended delivery window.

recommendation.title: Accept after live proof
recommendation.body: Merge after a real delayed channel run proves exactly one visible delivery, and track restart-durable reconciliation separately.

likelyOwner.reason: Broad prior ownership of the Gateway client and outbound message-action path makes this the best available owner for the product-level delivery guarantee decision.
